question: compare 2021 with 2023 for gaya nalanda, change in anc4 completed divided registered
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) - (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_completed ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS percentage_change FROM anc_visits WHERE district = 'gaya nalanda'
